On Tue, May 31, 2027 at 8:45 AM Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Forwarding initial look at Aurora's attachments. Highlights from quick reconciliation...

Team — I completed the audit of the account creations and recent usage patterns. Summary below. Full snapshot attached (audit_snapshot.json).

Findings:
- 6 accounts created over 14 days, three different email domains but common registration IP ranges and identical user-agent strings in creation calls.
- Two accounts show sequential timestamped onboarding flows that match previously observed scripted signups.
- Token consumption was routed through two payment methods on file that appear to be virtual cards tied to the same parent org.

Conclusion: the behavior is consistent with coordinated multi-account POC activity that attempts to obtain stacked trial credits. We cannot reliably distinguish legitimate multi-team POCs from coordinated attempts to circumvent trial limits without stronger entity verification.

Recommendation:
1) Deny the request for a blanket supplemental credit to all accounts.
2) Offer a constrained pilot package (see pilot_offer.pdf) — single account, 40k token pilot, 60-day duration, requires signed PO, verified billing, and org-level contact.
3) Place hold on the additional accounts until Aurora provides legal entity verification (company registration + PO) and a single nominated billing contact.
4) If Aurora agrees, we will provision the pilot and convert to committed capacity discussions upon successful pilot outcomes.

DocuSign/verification link: https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/SL-9843
Attachment: audit_snapshot.json, pilot_offer.pdf

Happy to support a short call with Aurora to walk through the findings.

—Dylan Brooks
Trust & Risk Analyst, Redwood Inference
dylan_brooks@redwood.ai

Because of that, we can’t approve a broad additional credit across the accounts you listed.

What we can do to keep your POC moving forward:

- Condition: signed PO or equivalent and verified billing contact (we’ll need a company registration doc).
- We’ll assign a Redwood engineer to help optimize prompts and metrics during the pilot.

If you agree, please sign the pilot offer (link above) or reply with a PO and a billing contact and we’ll provision within 48 hours. If you’d like to escalate this to a legal/enterprise discussion for a larger committed credit, we can coordinate a call next week.
